tips.menu: Four choices. Try ACT first: see what it likes.
tips.act: CHECK is free. Everything else takes a turn.
tips.mercy: The gold bar is its mercy odds. What you do moves them.
tips.spare: Its name is gold: it will likely accept. Try SPARE.
tips.strike: Press ENTER when the line crosses the middle.
tips.dodge: You are the white diamond. Arrows move it. Stay off what glows.
tips.ask: Friends make every fight easier, and the Last Door needs one.
tips.clans: Monsters talk. Its kin will hear what you just did.
tips.dead: Dying only starts this fight over.
tips.crack: That wall is cracked. Walk into it.
tips.boss: Champions change attack every turn. They can be won over too.
